pages.title: A night of jazz · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday evening in the old part of New Orleans. Colorful lights hang over a busy street. Lia hears a trumpet and a drum. She follows the sound to a small stage. A man named Remy stands by the door with a guitar. He smiles and says hello.
“Hello! Do you like jazz?” says Remy. “Yes! Listen! Do you hear that trumpet?” says Lia. “Yes. My friend plays it every night.” says Remy.

pages.title: Laboratório de sons · o som
pages.what: Em hear, o “ea” soa “íi”: “RÍIR”. Em trumpet, o “u” soa “a”: “TRÂM-pet”.
pages.how: Diga hear como “RÍIR”. Diga trumpet como “TRÂM-pet”.
pages.tip: Compare hear e here: soam igual.
